{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for rows with revenue = 999999.99 (QA orders)
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}")

# Check if any such rows are in the target population
qa_in_target = qa_orders[(qa_orders['customer_segment'] == 'new') & (qa_orders['channel'] == 'paid_search')]
print(f"QA orders in target population: {len(qa_in_target)}")

# Show the first few QA orders
test_qa = qa_orders.head()
test_qa"}
